_meta.source: Traditional Indian Vastu Shastra Architectural Canons (Manasara, Mayamata, Samarangana Sutradhara) reconciled with National Building Code of India (NBC 2016 Part 8) and IS 8888 Building Physics
_meta.coverage_scope_note: Version 1.0.0 defines the complete 8-direction entrance weight matrix, approach-road alignment criteria, 3x3 functional room grid with prohibitions and passive design reconciliations, and topographic drainage slope auspiciousness rules.

NE.canonical_significance: Most auspicious quadrant for primary entrance (Maha-Dwara); fosters spiritual clarity, prosperity, and cosmic equilibrium.

N.canonical_significance: Highly auspicious; governs wealth, prosperity, and progressive vitality; provides cool diffuse northern illumination.

E.canonical_significance: Auspicious portal welcoming beneficial morning ultraviolet solar rays and vitality.

NW.canonical_significance: Secondary acceptable entrance; governs movement, trade, and social guests; requires balanced fenestration.

W.canonical_significance: Neutral to acceptable for specific commercial and professional uses; requires thermal shading from harsh afternoon sun.

S.canonical_significance: Conditional entrance; auspicious when aligned with favorable sub-padas (Pushpadanta/Vithatha) and required by road frontage; requires internal entry foyer baffle.

SE.canonical_significance: Generally unfavorable for main residential gateway; acceptable primarily as secondary service or kitchen entrance.

SW.canonical_significance: Strictly discouraged in traditional canon for primary entrance; denotes structural dissipation and heavy instability; should remain heavy and enclosed.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: Ishanya is the sacred quadrant governed by water and divine ether; must remain clean, light, and unpolluted.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Northeast receives pure, glare-free morning daylight with minimal heat buildup; ideal for quiet reflection and clean water retention.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: Governed by Kubera (lord of wealth); open living zones here encourage harmonious social and economic interaction.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Consistent diffuse daylight without thermal solar gain makes North ideal for primary family gathering and daytime occupancy.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: Surya brings early solar energy and life vitality; wide openings in the East welcome positive daybreak light.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Captures low-angle morning solar rays that sanitize indoor spaces without excessive afternoon thermal loads.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: Domain of Agni (Fire deity); placing the cooking stove in the Southeast preserves energetic balance and family health.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Kitchen in SE allows early morning prep light while prevailing southwest winds naturally carry cooking heat and aromas out of the building.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: Requires moderate weight and intermediate stability; serves well as transitional living or storage space.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Acts as an effective thermal buffer against high southern solar radiation; deep overhangs protect south windows.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: Heaviest, most grounded quadrant; represents stability, leadership, and restful sleep for the head of household.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Provides maximum acoustic privacy from street noise and acts as high thermal mass shielding living zones from harsh afternoon western heat.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: Governed by Varuna; promotes balanced digestion, social dining, and structured intellectual study.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Provides warm evening daylight for dinner hours; vertical louvers or deep reveals shield windows from low-angle sunset glare.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: Domain of Vayu (Air); governs movement, guests, and cyclical changes; ideal for transient spaces.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Excellent natural ventilation and negative pressure exhaust zone for wet areas and plumbing shafts.

room_grid.vastu_rationale: The cosmic heart of the residence; must remain open, uncluttered, and spiritually resonant.
room_grid.civil_engineering_rationale: Central light-well or double-height hall drives natural stack-effect buoyancy ventilation, exhausting warm stale air through clerestories.

N.description: Terrain slopes toward North; gravity surface runoff aligns with natural drainage and promotes open northern daylight.

NE.description: Terrain slopes toward Northeast (Ishanya); canonical ideal for water runoff and morning solar orientation.

E.description: Terrain slopes toward East; promotes clean eastward stormwater discharge and unhindered sunrise light.

S.description: Terrain slopes toward South; requires raising southern plinth and installing perimeter interceptor swales to divert runoff.

SW.description: Terrain slopes toward Southwest (Nirriti); causes unwanted moisture surcharge along heavy foundations; remedial stepped retaining walls and northern bypass swales mandatory.

SE.description: Terrain slopes toward Southeast; manageable surface runoff with standard perimeter channel drains.

W.description: Terrain slopes toward West; standard stepped grading and western foundation damp-proofing required.

NW.description: Terrain slopes toward Northwest; standard perimeter gravity discharge toward municipal storm main.

reconciliation_principles.vastu_position: Agni (Fire) governs Southeast; kitchen must face East/Southeast for domestic harmony.
reconciliation_principles.scientific_passive_position: Southeast orientation captures early morning daylight for breakfast prep while prevailing Southwesterly winds naturally draft heat and fumes away from bedrooms.
reconciliation_principles.recommended_synthesis: Both traditions converge: locate the kitchen in Southeast with cooking counter along the eastern wall and exhaust fans on the southern/eastern facade.

reconciliation_principles.vastu_position: Nirriti represents stability and grounding; master suite must occupy Southwest.
reconciliation_principles.scientific_passive_position: Master bedroom and heavy wardrobe closets in Southwest act as a solid thermal buffer against harsh low-angle afternoon solar radiation.
reconciliation_principles.recommended_synthesis: Both traditions agree: position the master bedroom in Southwest with thick masonry walls and deep window overhangs.

reconciliation_principles.topic: Water Sump & Rainwater Harvesting in Northeast
reconciliation_principles.vastu_position: Ishanya is the water/ether quadrant; underground water storage brings health and prosperity.
reconciliation_principles.scientific_passive_position: Underground sump in Northeast keeps stored water cool away from southern heat; morning breezes across open water features provide passive evaporative cooling.
reconciliation_principles.recommended_synthesis: Install underground rainwater sump in the Northeast open setback with clean inspection access.

reconciliation_principles.vastu_position: Traditional canon discourages southern main entrance doors as Yama's portal.
reconciliation_principles.scientific_passive_position: When public municipal road is strictly on the South, direct vehicular and pedestrian access from the South is an engineering necessity.
reconciliation_principles.recommended_synthesis: Position the main boundary gate along the favorable southern pada (Pushpadanta/Vithatha), and utilize an angled internal entry foyer that redirects the front door visually toward the North or East.

reconciliation_principles.vastu_position: Vastu prioritizes East and North portals over Western entrances.
reconciliation_principles.scientific_passive_position: Commercial and retail properties mandate direct street visibility and pedestrian entry regardless of cardinal facing.
reconciliation_principles.recommended_synthesis: Provide western entrance for commercial foot traffic with deep recessed colonnades or vertical architectural fins to block low-angle afternoon solar glare.
